title: projection prefixes apply only to constructor targets
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

rejection.justification: spec 11.3: prefix use is resolved statically from the constructor target; the error precedes execution.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.3: prefixes do not apply to variables, member calls or arbitrary values.
